title: A polymer ascg builds, from a description: system and AA plan for review
prompt: I want a coarse-grained model of poly(methyl acrylate): atactic 10-mers, two beads per repeat unit (backbone and ester), fitted at 400 K and 500 K. I have no all-atom simulations, so ascg should build the all-atom system itself. Prepare the system description and the all-atom plan in a study called pma for me to review. Do not approve anything on my behalf and do not run any simulation.

checks.expr: r['check']['size']['chains'] == 50 and r['check']['size']['cg_beads'] == 1000 and r['check']['spec']['repeat_units'] == 10 and r['mapping'] == 'proposed'
